scope: Resident complete-suite screen; fresh-process qualification still required

advance_rule.interpretation: Necessary screening conditions only. Material order sensitivity, placebo-scale effects or concentration in one favorable quartet remain grounds to stop. No additional resident allocation, selected-sample replacement or post-hoc gate relaxation. A convincing result advances independent fresh-process qualification only.

caveat: Eight quartets in one process are not independent allocations. RR effects are reported separately, never subtracted. Leave-one-out values are a predeclared fragility guard, never a replacement estimator. No confidence interval or universal speedup is claimed; qualifying fresh-process evidence remains required.
